meta.title: Negative-asset scan (read-only)
meta.description: Read-only scan for project-level leftovers: empty dirs, zero-byte files, stale temp artifacts, duplicate copies, split-volume residue and replica-name copies. Every candidate carries a signal, a reason and a three-check layer (safe / doubt / ask); protected roots stay excluded fail-closed. P0 never deletes, moves or renames anything.
